title: BEACON governance parameters (ledger · SOP approval chain · retention sweep · drill mode)
description: Validates config/governance.json — the SOP approval chain (ADR-034 §6), the Art. XIV retention window enforced by the sweep executor (finding F-25) and the drill-mode default (ADR-034 §7). Governance parameters are DATA, never literals in a use-case (ADR-012). Every block MUST declare its own `basis` prose, so a number cannot be added or changed here without stating what grounds it — the same discipline as schemas/forecast-trigger.schema.json. This schema is deliberately NOT related to schemas/threshold-rule.schema.json, which is dead and drifted (findings F-33/F-80); it is live, and is pinned to the shipped config by src/application/governance/governance-config.test.ts.

approval.description: The SOP approval chain. Both roles are drawn from the APPROVER_ROLES set, so no value here can produce an approval that no human gave: a delegation widens WHO may approve, never WHETHER approval is required (CONSTITUTION Art. XIII). There is deliberately no `autoApproveAfterMinutes` and no `requireApproval` boolean — an unapprovable-by-anyone or auto-approved state is not expressible.

fallbackAfterMinutes.description: How long the primary authorizer holds SOLE responsibility before the fallback role becomes co-responsible. Must be > 0: a zero window is an always-open delegation and must be written as such, not as a timeout of nothing.

retention.description: The Art. XIV retention window the sweep executor enforces. Before MW-D/D4 `purgeAfter` was stamped and indexed with no executor, so the guarantee was claimed and unenforced (finding F-25).

publicReportRetentionDays.description: Days from intake to `purgeAfter`. Integer: retention stated in fractional days would be a deadline nobody can reason about.

sweepGraceMinutes.description: Extra minutes the sweep waits past a stamped `purgeAfter` deadline before deleting. 0 = delete exactly at the deadline. A non-zero value silently extends the retention the reporter was told about, so it must be justified in `basis`.

drill.description: Exercise (DRILL) mode default. The flag decides whether a drill composition is built; it is NOT what keeps an exercise artifact off a real channel — that is structural (ADR-034 §7, three layers, none a runtime branch).

approverRole.description: A role that carries approval authority (CONSTITUTION Art. XIII). PUBLIC and RESPONDER are deliberately NOT permitted — mirrors APPROVER_ROLES in src/domain/governance.ts.
